Thanks for the ping — diving in. A couple quick notes from the infra side:
- When calendar providers auto-populate conferencing, they can sometimes swap providers if both Zoom and Google Meet links are present in the event metadata. That can happen if an invite is created from a mobile device or a forwarding flow.
- For this meeting, I will: create a brand-new Zoom meeting (no registration, join before host ON), disable any SSO-only enforcement for the meeting, and send the direct join URL.

Attached is a short troubleshooting note for SSO-related issues on the Acme side (acme-sso-troubleshooting.pdf). If IT needs help whitelisting a Zoom domain, we can coordinate.
